deadline.value: The Fall application deadline is January 1, with decisions by April 15.
deadline.quote: Fall semester application deadline | graduate program is January 1st

gre_general.value: All applicants must submit GRE General scores taken within the past five years.
gre_general.quote: All applicants are required to provide scores for the Graduate Record Examination (GRE) General Exam, taken within the past five years

gre_subject.value: The subject GRE in Physics is not required.
gre_subject.quote: The subject GRE in Physics is not required

toefl_min.value: International applicants need TOEFL iBT 80 for regular admission; a Speaking score of 22 is needed for a TA.
toefl_min.quote: International students must present a score on the Test of English as a Foreign Language | in order to qualify for regular admission to the program

also.quote: An iBT score of 22 or higher on the Speaking portion is required

supervisor.value: Admission is not tied to a named supervisor. A research advisor is needed by the end of the first full year.
supervisor.quote: Graduate students must have a research advisor by the end of the spring semester of their first full academic year

funding.value: Assistantships are limited and the admission process is competitive. The minimum PhD stipend is $24,000 a year.
funding.quote: the number of assistantships is always limited and the admission process is competitive

also.quote: The current minimum stipend for PhD students is $24,000 annually

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in physics or a related field with a 2.7 GPA is enough to apply.
entry_route.quote: The requirements for admission to the graduate program consist of a bachelor

notes: Concentrations in astrophysics and materials science (handbook) are listed as also_fields. The handbook also lists medical physics, which is not a field id. The medical physics cycle was not fetched and is not recorded.
